objects.name: SAP MM Module
objects.description: Materials-management module of SAP; source system for the Inventory Aging extract, output as a pipe-delimited TXT file at month end.

objects.name: Hardcoded Inventory File Path
objects.description: Inventory Power BI file is hardcoded to D:\Data\PBI_Refresh\Inventory\Raw\, same limitation as Revenue/Returns.

objects.name: Retrieve SAP MM Inventory Extract
objects.description: Receive the pipe-delimited Inventory_Aging_MMMYYYY.txt file, auto-emailed by the ERP team; exact recipient email address to be confirmed with Vijay.

objects.name: Import Pipe-Delimited Inventory File
objects.description: Must use Excel's Import function (not double-click-open) or the pipe-delimited data collapses into a single column.

objects.name: Four Aging Bucket Columns Required
objects.description: The dashboard requires exactly four aging columns in order (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90-plus); missing any one causes a PBI error.

objects.name: ERP Extract Sometimes Omits 90-Plus Column
objects.description: The SAP MM extraction occasionally drops the 90-plus aging column entirely when there is no data in it; must be added back manually as an empty column.

objects.name: No Formal Quantity Cross-Check Formula
objects.description: Total quantity is meant to roughly match the Supply Chain report but there is no documented cross-check formula; previously done by eye, flagging if off by more than 10-15%.

objects.name: ERP Extraction Issue Contact
objects.description: ERP/SAP MM extraction issues are escalated to Vijay.
